question: Hood lowered in impending rain
decision: Russian says lower the hood too. Preserve inherited wording; do not invent physical correction.

question: Trinity day
decision: Orthodox Trinity feast is Pentecost, not the subsequent Western Trinity Sunday. Danish pinsedag; modern English should clarify Pentecost/Trinity feast.

question: Garnett quart versus pint for same vessel
evidence: Lines180,182,188 all use полуштоф for same half-shtof bottle. Garnett changes quart to pint, neither a consistent precise rendering.
decision: Harmonized all references to this half-shtof vessel as bottle/flaske across2/6,21,26,31,32,36; no invented imperial conversion.
